title: Inner product of the monotonicity family
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Form a family indexed by $s\in F_2^{k+1}$ that equals $f$ when the last coordinate of $s$ is $0$, and equals the constant function $1$ when that coordinate is nonzero. Its Gowers inner product equals the diagonal inner product in dimension $k$, namely the inner product of the family that assigns $f$ to every point of $F_2^k$.
